test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In 2021, which State Government was in the news for planning to set up a Vedic Education and Sanskar Board to revive the knowledge of Sanskrit scriptures and Vedas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In February 2021, the Rajasthan government announced its plan to set up a Vedic Education and Sanskar Board to revive the knowledge of Sanskrit scriptures and Vedas.**
 
• The board aims to promote and preserve **ancient Indian knowledge** and culture.
 
• The board will work towards providing education on ancient Indian scriptures, including **Vedas, Puranas, and Upanishads**.
 
• The board will also provide training for priests and ensure the quality of **Vedic education** in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Minister of State (MoS) for Sanskrit Education Subhash Garg stated that modules will be put before the board based on the report of a committee that was constituted to describe the goals, objectives, and operation of the board.**
 
• The committee submitted its report to the** state government.**
 
• He said that the Chief Minister** Ashok Gehlot's **approval will be required for the Vedic board to begin operations.
